description: [WRITE] Create an Amazon Ads Conversions API SERVER tag from the Stape template (stape-io/amazon-tag), imported automatically. No token: the only credential is tagIds (the Amazon Ads Tag UUIDs) plus tagRegion (NA | EU). Omit `event` to inherit; pass an Amazon standard event (Off-AmazonPurchases, Lead, …) or a GA4 name. eventId is the clientDedupeId dedup row. containerId must be the SERVER container. Needs a SERVER trigger (triggers_create) passed as firingTriggerId. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this write operation.

containerId.description: The SERVER container ID (for the plan tool: the WEB container).

customAttributes.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

firingTriggerId.description: SERVER trigger id(s) the tag fires on (triggers_create, type customEvent). Usually one.

name.description: Tag name; defaults to "Amazon Ads CAPI Tag".

userData.description: Override rows {name, value}; names are the template's own field keys.

name: create_amazon_capi_server_tag
